definition: The Semitic word-formation system where a consonantal root (ك-ت-ب, "writing") interleaves with templatic patterns to derive related words (كتاب book, مكتبة library, كاتب writer).
details: The Semitic word-formation system where a consonantal root (ك-ت-ب, "writing") interleaves with templatic patterns to derive related words (كتاب book, مكتبة library, كاتب writer). Explains why stemming Arabic is nontrivial and why subword tokenizers trained mostly on English split Arabic poorly.
